reason: This provisional single-file registry (registry_version 1) has been replaced by a formal two-file business rules layer (human-readable Markdown single source of truth + machine-readable YAML), per explicit instruction, so that confirmed rules persist as project files rather than only in conversation context and can be read by Agents on any model. Do NOT read this file for rule content anymore.

rule_id_migration.note: The old registry_version-1 rule_id numbering is NOT compatible with the new registry's numbering. Any Artifact produced before 2026-08-20 that cites an old rule_id under this file must be reinterpreted using this mapping, and should ideally be regenerated by re-running the producing Agent.
